questions.text: In IEEE 754 single precision, how many bits are allocated to the sign, exponent and mantissa respectively?
questions.explain: Single precision is 32 bits total: 1 sign, 8 biased exponent (bias 127), 23 stored mantissa bits with an implicit leading 1. Double precision is 1, 11, 52.

questions.text: What is the range of integers representable in 8-bit two's complement?
questions.explain: Two's complement in n bits covers -2^(n-1) to 2^(n-1) - 1, so -128 to 127. The asymmetry exists because zero has a single representation.

questions.text: Simplify the expression AB + A(B + C) + B(B + C).
questions.explain: Expand: AB + AB + AC + BB + BC = AB + AC + B + BC. Since B absorbs AB and BC, the result is B + AC.

questions.text: What is the minimum number of 2-to-1 multiplexers required to implement an 8-to-1 multiplexer, using no other gates?
questions.explain: A binary tree of 2-to-1 multiplexers: four in the first level, two in the second, one in the third. Total 4 + 2 + 1 = 7.

questions.text: How many select lines and how many outputs does a 1-to-16 demultiplexer have?
questions.explain: Routing one input to any of 16 outputs needs log2(16) = 4 select lines.

questions.text: What is the minimum number of flip-flops required to build a modulo-10 synchronous counter?
questions.explain: n flip-flops give 2^n states. Ten states need 2^n >= 10, so n = 4, with six unused states.

questions.text: Which flip-flop configuration eliminates the invalid state of an SR latch?
options: Tying the two inputs together in a JK flip-flop to form a T flip-flop
A D flip-flop, which derives S and R from a single input
Adding a clock to the SR latch
Using NOR gates instead of NAND gates
questions.explain: A D flip-flop drives S = D and R = NOT D, so S and R can never be asserted together. The JK flip-flop instead defines the former invalid combination as a toggle.

questions.text: A four-variable function has minterms 0, 1, 2, 3, 8, 9, 10, 11. What is the minimal sum-of-products expression, with variables A B C D from most to least significant?
questions.explain: Those eight minterms are exactly the cells where B = 0, covering both A = 0 and A = 1 with all combinations of C and D. The function reduces to B'.

questions.text: Adding two 8-bit two's complement numbers 01111111 and 00000001 gives 10000000. What does this indicate?
options: Signed overflow, because two positives produced a negative
A carry out of the most significant bit
questions.explain: Signed overflow is detected when the carry into the sign bit differs from the carry out of it, or equivalently when two positives yield a negative. 127 + 1 cannot be held in 8-bit signed form.
